repo.description: Watched repository as owner/name — REQUIRED per deployment. Drives the webhook repo filter. For this bundle: ktbhealth/product.

webhook_secret_env.description: Env var holding this repo's webhook HMAC secret — the BUPHA_WH_<OWNER>_<REPO> convention (uppercased, '-' → '_'). REQUIRED per deployment; the var must exist in the campaign service env (~/.config/peregrin/env or cuora).

worktree_base.description: Per-sha run state (run-<sha>/) and throwaway clones (wt-<sha>/) land here. MUST be absolute.

docs_repo_url.description: Docs repo clone URL — pushed via http.extraHeader + GITHUB_TOKEN, so https (no ssh-agent needed).

product_repo_url.description: Product repo clone URL — every git call carries the token header (private repo).

bun_bin.description: bun binary dir prepended to PATH inside regen — systemd services get a minimal PATH.
